phone.title: Ibipimo by'ubuzima bivuye muri telefoni
phone.intro: Rinda ishobora gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima telefoni yawe isanzwe ibika muri Apple Health cyangwa Health Connect, nk'umutima utera, intambwe, ibitotsi, umuvuduko w'amaraso n'ibiro. Hoherezwa incamake imwe gusa ku munsi, kandi ushobora guhagarika igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
phone.share: Sangiza Rinda ibipimo by'ubuzima biri muri telefoni yanjye
phone.onlyApp: Ibi bikora muri porogaramu ya Rinda kuri telefoni, aho telefoni yawe yemerera Rinda gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima.
phone.failed: Rinda ntiyashoboye gusoma amakuru y'ubuzima ya telefoni yawe. Reba ko Health Connect (Android) cyangwa Apple Health (iPhone) yemerera Rinda kuyasoma.
phone.iosNote: Kuri iPhone, Apple ntibwira porogaramu ibipimo wemeye, bityo igipimo kibura gishobora kuba kitarasangijwe.
phone.off: Ibipimo by'ubuzima bivuye muri telefoni ntibirafungurwa.
phone.filled: Byuzujwe uhereye kuri telefoni yawe. Reba imibare mbere yo gukomeza.
phone.noRecent: Nta bipimo bya vuba biri muri telefoni yawe.

sms.title: Ubutumwa bugufi (SMS)
sms.body: Akira ubutumwa bugufi nyuma ya buri suzuma burimo ibisubizo n'imibare yawe, inama n'umurongo wa raporo yose. Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro ntibijya byoherezwa. Umuntu wese ushobora gufungura telefoni yawe ashobora kubusoma.
sms.toggle: Nyoherereza incamake z'isuzuma ryanjye kuri SMS
sms.needPhone: Shyiramo nimero ya telefoni yawe muri "Amakuru yanjye" hejuru kugira ngo ububone.

delivery.title: Twakoherereza dute ibisubizo by'isuzuma ryawe?
delivery.body: Nyuma ya buri suzuma, Rinda ishobora kukoherereza incamake. Hitamo ikikunogeye. Ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose mu Mwirondoro wawe.
delivery.failed: Ibyo wahisemo ntibyashoboye kubikwa. Ongera ugerageze.
